import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.Proper
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.PullbackCarrier

/-!
# Whole fibres contained in an open subscheme

For a universally closed morphism `f : X ⟶ S` and an open `U` of `X`,
the complement of `f(X \ U)` is an open of `S`. Its formation commutes
with arbitrary base change, and it represents the condition that the
base-changed total space maps into `U`.

This is the proper-image construction in the proof of Kleiman,
*The Picard scheme*, Section 3, Theorem `th:repDiv`. Application to the
divisor locus additionally requires an open Cartier locus and relative
flatness of the quotient family.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

variable {X S T : Scheme.{u}}

/-- The largest base open whose entire inverse image lies in `U`. -/
def wholeFiberOpen (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f] (U : X.Opens) : S.Opens :=
  ⟨Set.kernImage f U, isClosedMap_iff_kernImage.mp f.isClosedMap U.isOpen⟩

@[simp]
theorem mem_wholeFiberOpen (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f]
    (U : X.Opens) (s : S) :
    s ∈ wholeFiberOpen f U ↔ ∀ x : X, f x = s → x ∈ U := Iff.rfl

/-- Whole-fibre containment is the right adjoint to inverse image on opens. -/
theorem le_wholeFiberOpen_iff (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : S.Opens) :
    V ≤ wholeFiberOpen f U ↔ f ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ U := by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    exact (h hx) rfl
  · intro h s hs x hx
    apply h
    change f x ∈ V
    rwa [hx]

theorem preimage_wholeFiberOpen_le (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f]
    (U : X.Opens) : f ⁻¹ᵁ wholeFiberOpen f U ≤ U :=
  (le_wholeFiberOpen_iff f U _).mp le_rfl

/-- The proper-image open commutes with arbitrary scheme base change.
The converse inclusion uses the existence of a point of the scheme fibre
product over every compatible pair of points. -/
theorem wholeFiberOpen_pullback (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f]
    (g : T ⟶ S) (U : X.Opens) :
    wholeFiberOpen (pullback.snd f g) (pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U) =
      g ⁻¹ᵁ wholeFiberOpen f U := by
  ext t
  constructor
  · intro ht x hx
    obtain ⟨z, hzx, hzt⟩ := Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback x t hx
    have hz := ht hzt
    change pullback.fst f g z ∈ U at hz
    rwa [hzx] at hz
  · intro ht z hzt
    apply ht
    have h := congrArg (fun a : pullback f g ⟶ S => a z)
      (pullback.condition (f := f) (g := g))
    simpa only [Hom.comp_apply, hzt] using h

/-- A test lands in the whole-fibre open exactly when its entire
base-changed total space lands in the chosen total-space open. -/
theorem range_subset_wholeFiberOpen_iff (f : X ⟶ S) [UniversallyClosed f]
    (g : T ⟶ S) (U : X.Opens) :
    Set.range g ⊆ wholeFiberOpen f U ↔ Set.range (pullback.fst f g) ⊆ U := by
  constructor
  · intro h z hz
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hz
    apply h ⟨pullback.snd f g w, rfl⟩
    exact congrArg (fun a : pullback f g ⟶ S => a w)
      (pullback.condition (f := f) (g := g))
  · intro h s hs x hx
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨z, hzx, _⟩ := Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback x t hx
    exact h ⟨z, hzx⟩

/-- The whole-fibre open has the expected unique factorization property
on all test schemes. -/
theorem existsUnique_factor_wholeFiberOpen_iff (f : X ⟶ S)
    [UniversallyClosed f] (g : T ⟶ S) (U : X.Opens) :
    (∃! l : T ⟶ (wholeFiberOpen f U).toScheme,
      l ≫ (wholeFiberOpen f U).ι = g) ↔
      Set.range (pullback.fst f g) ⊆ U := by
  rw [← range_subset_wholeFiberOpen_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨l, hl, _⟩ s ⟨t, rfl⟩
    rw [← hl]
    exact (l t).property
  · intro h
    have hrange : Set.range g ⊆ Set.range (wholeFiberOpen f U).ι := by
      rwa [Opens.range_ι]
    refine ⟨IsOpenImmersion.lift (wholeFiberOpen f U).ι g hrange,
      IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ hrange, ?_⟩
    intro l hl
    apply (cancel_mono (wholeFiberOpen f U).ι).mp
    rw [hl, IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac]

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
